balls.text: slower one bowled short outside off, swings and misses, steals a bye
gone, Gilly has to go, full toss and he tried to be cheeky there, steered it straight to a perfectly-positioned Gayle at short third man
the punishment continues, pitched up and it's sliced over point, Bangalore have no answers to his

Century for Gilchrist, overdue you would think for this season, full and wide and he hammered it over extra cover, plenty of runs in that region today and a fitting way to reach the landmark, well done, riding on the Punjab resurgence is Gilly
short on middle, pulled on the bounce straight to deep square leg, just a single
low full toss, driven wide of deep midwicket for a couple of runs
four leg-byes, full delivery on the pads, was looking to just nudge it around to keep strike, instead it clipped his shoe and raced down the third-man boundary, it's his day, folks
Gilchrist wastes no time, though. Short ball, was the slower one again but ended up being a long hop, Gilchrist sent it over deep square leg
another slower one, chooses to just play it around for a single, gets an inside edge onto his pads
three dot balls in a row, full outside off, tries to squeeze it out, misses, was the back of the hand slower ball that kept low
swing and a miss again, slower one but he was onto it a little too early
slower one bowled on a length outside off, targets cow-corner does Marsh and misses
Gilchrist misses out, or does he? Targeting the pads again and he tries to glance it fine, doesn't get bat but it deflects off the pads to beat the keeper and short fine leg, four more
low full toss on middle, driven down towards deep midwicket for a single
on the pads and he tried to swing him over square leg, struck high on the pads, a single in the end
doling out length deliveries, Gilly is on his way to a century, stood his ground and crunched it past extra cover
good yorker, on middle, dug out into the leg side
No he can't!! Slower one bowled on a length and Gilly picked it, smashing it over long-off
full outside off, reached for it and got an inside edge for a single, good comeback from Mithun this over after that first-ball treatment
just a single again, just pushed a wide one down towards long-off
missed out there, full toss and Gilchrist failed to connect as he tried to dispatch it, the keeper fumbled as well
a dare dot ball, full outside off, tries to squeeze it to third man, misses, stifled appeal turned down
fuller, almost a yorker, dug out for a single into the off side
no respite for Bangalore, width and length and Marsh caresses it with a full-blooded drive past extra cover
played away to long-on for a single
finally finds one in the blockhole, digs it wide of cover, raises the 150-stand, the highest for any wicket in any edition of the IPL, what entertainment
found the gap again, full toss and he knows how to deal with those, chipped it between long-on and deep midwicket and you know the result
the batsman wins in the end as the wicketkeeper misses, just outside leg stump, Gilly tried to dismiss it over midwicket, missed and so did Arun Karthik whose view was blocked
makes room and smacks it to deep midwicket for one more
fires it full on leg stump, chipped wide of deep midwicket for a single
a Tendulkaresque lofted drive to finish it off, what an over, pitched up again and he launched it over the bowler's head for a meaty six, lovely shot, Punjab are all over Bangalore here
Marsh is unstoppable here, van der Wath can only scratch his head, pitched up and that was drilled over the covers
beautifully placed, it was a full toss and he found the gap with perfection, making a bit of room and pushing it firmly between extra cover and long-off, the carnage continues
a fifty for Marsh, continuing his prolific run, aiming for th eblockhole but he isn't getting it right, driven hard over extra cover
the fun continues, van der Wath overcompensates for the length ball, holds it back to produce a long hop and it's disappeared over deep midwicket
only to be thrashed for six! Begins with a length ball and Marsh sweetly lofts him over long-off, clears the ropes by a distance, Bangalore are struggling
dropped, but that was a really tough chance, drilled wide of long-on where Kaif flung himself to his right but was unable to hold on, the partnership continues
made some room and Gayle chased him, hurled it hard down the leg side and Marsh just helped it on its way to the fine-leg boundary
in the blockhole on leg stump, dug out wide of midwicket, enough time for both batsmen to complete the second
targeting leg stump again, tries to whip it fine, gets a leg-bye instead
fires it quick on leg stump, clipped past deep square leg, two more for Gilly
full on middle and leg, worked away through the leg side for a single
slower one bowled full on middle and leg, clipped through square leg for a single
pitched up outside off, driven straight to extra cover
turned away to square leg for a single
Gilchrist a touch fortunate there, tried to swing it over midwicket but ended up getting an inside edge past the keeper to the fine-leg boundary
nicely struck, poor ball but it was crunched through deep extra cover
full toss on middle, swept towards square leg for a single
gets hold of that one, was pitched around a good length, he bent slightly and picked it over deep midwicket, just about managed to evade Langeveldt
full on the pads and Gilchrist went for it, will feel he missed out there, was right in the slot, just a leg bye in the end
slips a wide down the leg side
well fielded at long-on, chipped past long-on where Mohammad Kaif dives to his right to keep them down to one, was struck well
nicely timed this time, full toss, a low one outside off, steered wide of deep point for a single
Marsh fails to take advantage, full toss outside off, tries to caress it square but can't get his bat onto that one
another no-ball, pushed uppishly towards long-off for a single, another freehit, Bangalore in some trouble here
gets away with it, full outside off, crunched wide of extra cover for a brace
full and wide, Gilchrist slashes hard, gets a thick edge and it races away to the third-man boundary, what's worse for Bangalore, it's a no-ball

low full toss outside off, dug out towards extra cover, Marsh had left his crease at the non-striker's end and Kohli spotted that, aimed accurately at the stumps, giving Marsh a wake-up call. Asad Rauf has called for a replay, which suggests Marsh has just about made it. It's touch and go. Excellent fielding, though he's just made it
back of a length on leg stump, swivels and pats it wide of short fine for a single
pitched up on the off, driven hard down to long-off for a single
full and he keeps strike by pushing it down to long-off for a single

three in a row, Gilchrist is out of control here, short on middle and he seizes the lenght early to pull it over square leg, Kohli is speechless, that also brings up Gilchrist's fifty, a hurricane innings this
another six, this one was just a jab, full toss around wasit high and Gilchrist punches it over midwicket, lands on the ropes and that means it's six
picked the slower one and sent it out of Dharamsala, landed on a length and he sent it miles behind deep square leg, he's finally arrived this IPL has Gilly
bouncer and it's too short, called a wide for height
pitched up outside off, mistimes a drive down towards long-on for a single
short of a good length on the off, chops it wide of point for a single
jabs it into the leg side for a single to keep strike
that's his favoured slog-sweep, was flighted again, landed full outside off and he swung it calmly over the deep midwicket boundaryt, off the meat and cleared the ropes by a distance
Gilchrist, meanwhile, cashes in on a full delivery, was tossed up and he cracked it hard and flat over long-off
pushed straight to extra cover
big swing, misses, goes for the slog-sweep, was tossed up and he was targeting the midwicket boundary, didn't connect and the keeper fumbled
shortish on the off, punched wide of long-on for a single
nicely done, waited for it to come on, was the slower one, and opened the face at the right time, late-cutting it past the keeper for four more, Punjab are picking up the pace, time for the timeout
Marsh connects superbly, you almost thought that was Gilly for a moment, short and he gets into position early, rocking back to pull it confidently over the midwicket boundary
slower one bowled slightly short, run down to third man for a single
vintage Gilly, in the slot on off stump and Gilchrist had made his mind up, hammering it over the bowler's head this time for a one bounce four
gave him the charge to counter any of that movement or bounce, took it off the length and smashed it over mid-off's head, just managed to clear the ropes
good delivery, short of a good length and got it to nip away at just the right time, Gilchrist poked at that one but couldn't get bat onto it
back of a length, around off, pushed to point
Gilchrist looks for another pull, but this one skids on, and concedes just the leg-bye
worked away off the hips for a single
fuller and angled across him, Gilchrist stays back and chips it over extra cover

Gilchrist's 100th Twenty20 six, and what a typical beauty it is. Judges the length early, which is not all too short, but rocks back and pulls this over deep square, deep into the stands. Trademark shot
struck on the thigh as he looks to work this away, although for a second I thought he shouldered arms towards the end
superb end yo a superb over, after bowling offcutters, gets this one to hold its line, and Marsh's outside edge is beaten as he looks for a big one down the ground
cramped up again with a shortish delivery, nipping into him
nice offcutter, starts outside off, cramps him up as he looks to run this down
slower ball this time, Marsh checks the drive, gets the inside half of the bat towards mid-on
fullish, driven on the up, can't beat mid-off
this is 2001st as he dabs this towards third man
slower ball outside off, Marsh swings without feet movement, is beaten
defended towards cover, no room this time
superb shot, short-arm pull, which means he has converted this shortish length into pulling length, and over square leg
looks to work this off the hip, misses, the ball rolls off the thigh pad
extra bounce as he angles this across him, and Marsh tentatively pokes at it
back of a length, no room, Marsh stays back and defends
short of a good length, not timing it too well is the man, played away into the off side as he tries to punch that

Valthaty goes, slower one bowled short on the off and Valthaty tries to swat that hard over the in-field, ends up slicing it, gets a lot of elevation and Saurabh Tiwary, at mid-off, waits patiently and holds on to a good catch
aiming for hte blockhole and almost gets it right, Valthaty chooses to play that cautiously, getting forward to defend it into the off side
pitched up on middle, chipped it over midwicket for a couple of runs
banged in short on leg stump, called a wide, a touch too high
streaky Valthaty, lands on a length on the off, tries to smash that over the bowler's head after making room, gets a thick outside edge over the slips and wide of third man
fraction short and Gilchrist tries to pull that over square leg, struck on the thigh as it came onto him a little quickly, a leg bye stolen
fires in a quicker one on leg stump, tries to launch it over midwicket once again but makes no contact, good start by Gayle
full toss, pushed wide of extra cover and the fielder there overruns the ball, a couple of runs due to that lapse, Asad Pathan was the man there
flighted on leg stump, tried to swing it over midwicket but was caught on the pads, strong breeze blowing
short of a good length on the off, mistimed it wide of cover for a single
pushed it quicker on leg stump, went back to work it square but was struck high on the pads
slightly short outside off, cut away straight to point
bouncer and a good one, banged in on middle and Valthaty ducks under it well
around a good length, nipping down leg, Gilchrist tries to turn that square but is unable to make contact with the bat again, clips the pads and they take a leg bye
around leg stump again, Gilchrist looks to glance that fine but it clips the pads
down the leg side, slightly short but it's misdirected, called a wide
shortish on the off, rocks on the back foot to punch it past the bowler for a single
good comeback, short of a good length on the off, nipped away as Valthaty went for it, went past the outside edge
short and wide, contrasting start compared to van der Watch, gifts him a hit-me delivery and Valthaty takes full toll, rocking back to crash that over the covers for a flat six
pitched up and it's driven hard and uppishly but lands just short of mid-off, they pinch a quick single
beautifully clipped away, landed in the slot on leg stump and he picked it nicely over midwicket
back of a length on middle and off, rocks back and drops it in front of the bowler
darted away after pitching around a good length, Valthaty stood his ground and tried to smash that through the covers, made no contact
short of a good length outside off, chases it and makes no contact, nipped away again
a lovely delivery that Dale Steyn would be proud of, landed on a good length on leg stump and zipped away as Valthaty tried to close the face, beat him completely
bowled'im, Punjab have thumped Bangalore, short and he moves away to pull it, misses and we know the rest
slapped past the bowler for a single
four more, driven over the bowler's head, Chawla ran across from long-off, got a hand to it and Hussey, running from long-on, overran it as Chawla misfielded
short and wide, finds the gap, slashing it between point and short third man for a boundary
slower one, moves away and chips him over extra cover
clipped off his pads past midwicket for a single
nicely struck, picked the slower one this time, was in the slot and he launched it over long-off, runs again from Harris but he also got a wicket
slower one bowled short outside off, makes room to smote that over cover, can't reach it
back of a length outside off, run down to third man for a single
gone, landed full and he made room, only to chip it straight to David Hussey at mid-on
pitched up and it's driven hard towards mid-off
beautifully picked up, slightly short, he swivels and whips that over the fine-leg boundary, lovely shot
has a swing at that one, drags it to deep midwicket for a single, the end of a successful spell
quicker delivery again on middle, mistimes a pull in the vacant midwicket region, single
gets forward and knocks it in front of cover
gets a stride out and plays it towards cover
flighted on the off, pushed back to the bowler

done in by the googly again, Chawla takes his fourth, pushed that one in quicker and van der Wath tried to close the face on that one, missed as he went across and looked to be struck in line with middle and leg, Asad Rauf had no doubts about that one
makes room and just manages to chip that slower delivery, that he didn't pick, over cover for a couple
squeezed it wide of extra cover for a single
good length on the off, gets forward and pushes it towards extra cover
gets on the back foot and nudges it wide of midwicket, enough time there to come back for the second
driven hard down the ground towards long-on where David Hussey runs across to cut it off
short one first up, goes for the pull, doesn't connect

domination from Punjab, 50th wicketkeeping dismissal for Gilchrist in the IPL, AB went for the slog-sweep, was the googly again, got a top edge and Gilly did the rest running in the direction of square leg
the googly and the turn and the extra bounce surprised de Villiers, he was struck high on the pads as he tried to play that from the crease
gets forward and plays it to short third man
shortish on middle, gets across and knocks it round the corner
bowled'im, flighted and was the googly, he just missed it did Karthik, tried to drive it through the off side, landed full on the off and struck off
finds the gap, was tossed up, landed outside off, he had picked his spot had Karthik, swept it between deep square leg and long leg
banged in short on middle, mistimes a pull past square leg for a single
slaps it straight back onto the stumps at the non-striker's end
good length, tonked it over the bowler's head for a couple, Karthik was running to the bowler's end, got there in time as Valthaty didn't collect the throw
slower one bowled on middle, driven down to long-on for a single
punched back down the ground to long-off for a single
shortish on middle, pulled past midwicket for a couple in the deep as David Hussey cuts it off
short, dragged wide of midwicket
the googly and it deceives everyone, including the keeper, bounced more than he expected, went through the gate and past Gilchrist

stumped, flighted outside off and it turned away sharply, tried to drive it through the line but the turn was too much for Kaif who lost his balance as he leant forward, Gilly missed taking off the bails on the first attempt but got it right on the second
shortish outside off, chopped down to point
flighted outside off, chipped wide of deep extra cover for a brace
gets on the back foot and turns it towards square leg
stands tall and drives it on the up to long-off
nicely placed, a bit of width on that one, moved away and sliced it over point for a boundary
dibbly dobbly mediums, played back to the bowler
full outside off, pushed firmly towards long-off for a single
angling in towards off, gets forward and defends it to the bowler
cracked down towards long-off for a single
pushed past point for a quick single to keep strike, time for the timeout
the googly again, turning in from outside off, gets on the back foot and defends
quicker through the air, short ball outside off, chopped it in front of the keeper
the googly, didn't pick it, played a little outside the line to that one, got an inside edge onto the pads
AB uses his feet superbly, dances down the track to that flighted delivery and sends it over long-on in one clean strike
shortish outside off, turning away, punched to extra cover
back of a length on the off, knocked it down in front of point
four more, three this over, straying on the pads is Shalabh, tickled down to the fine-leg boundary, easy pickings
short of a good length on the off, punched straight to extra cover
four more for Kaif, another short delivery on middle, pulled away yet again past square leg
back of a length on the off, knocks it down on the pitch
starts well does Kaif, short ball on middle and it's struck, pulled rather, past square leg for a boundary
gone! Not as full as the previous delivery, Asad, predictably, looked to launch it into McLeodganj, miscued it and found a patient David Hussey at cover
connects and connects well, length ball, he's been going after it from his first ball, got it off the meat this time and cleared deep midwicket
good length, a touch wide, tries to smash him down the ground, misses
pushed down the ground to long-on for a single
Asad goes for it first up, pitched up and he went for it over midwicket, got a thick outside edge on the bounce to third man
gentle medium, pushed towards deep point for a single
Srivastava can't control himself, is ecstatic after dismissing Tiwary, who pulled a short one straight to midwicket
gets back and knocks it down into the leg side for a single
absolutely murdered, good length and he opted to play it off the back foot,. just had so much time to play it, rocked back and hammered it past cover
shortish on middle, gets on the back foot and plays it to the bowler
short on the off, goes for the pull gets an inside edge towards fine leg for a couple of runs
short of a good length outside off, chops it down to point
dropped, was in the firing line was Praveen, shortish and Tiwary punched it back hard, Praveen got a hand to it, he was a little late to react, and it rolled past mid-on all the way to the ropes
fullish on middle, AB got across to drive it down the ground, got an inside edge onto his pads
nicely struck, good length, leant forward did AB and creamed it past the diving extra cover, lovely timing
back of a length on middle, drops it into the off side for a quick single
held it back, short on the off, punched back hard towards the bowler, got his body behind it did Praveen and stopped it awkwardly
Praveen continues to beat the bat, on a good length and has Tiwary driving at it, only to miss it

Harris is going for a few runs but is getting the wickets, short ball on the off, Kohli tried to pull that in front of square, got a top edge and Karthik at slip timed his jump well to clasp it over his head
juicy delivery on the pads, clipped over midwicket for a delicious four
on a length again and he punches it back over the bowler's head, didn't come off the meat but was hit well enough

dropped, Valthaty ran back from mid-off, it took ages to come down and a dive in the end was in vain, pitched up and Kohli went downtown, didn't get hold of it at all, Valthaty kept his eyes on it but was never in control of that one
short and wide and Kohli tries to slash it hard, it's too wide though and it's called
on a good length on middle, driven straight towards mid-on, dot balls galore
short of a good length on the off, pushed into the off side towards point
playing inside the line was Tiwary, Praveen got it to nip away again and beat the outside edge, superb spell thus far
moving away again, short of a good length again, Tiwary lets it go this time
short of a good length, gets it to swing and move away, beaten was Tiwary as he poked at it
short of a good length outside off, punched past point for a quick single
full outside off, tries to drive it hard through mid-on but mistimes it
angling in towards middle, gets across to play it towards midwicket
pitched up and he chaes that one, tries to hammer it down the ground but makes no contact
angling in towards middle, gets across to tickle it down to fine leg for a single
short of a good length outside off, nips away and he lets it go

Gayle's gone! A seven-ball duck, Punjab are on a high, good length and some width on offer and he is tempted to chase that, gets a big nick and Gilly, with the form he is in, dives full length to his left to pluck that out one-handed in front of slip
good length on leg stump, turned past midwicket for a single, first runs off the bat
fullish on the off, gets forward and opens the face to play it to cover
three wides, but that didn't seem like one, full and it's called by the umpire though it seems a little harsh
wide down the leg side again, much wider than the previous one
down the leg side, Gayle tries to glance it fine, misses, called a wide
A maiden over to Gayle, a commendable effort, beautiful delivery once again, swinging away and nipping away further, Gayle opts out of that one, good start for Punjab
swing and a miss, good length and it nips away, tries to swing it down the ground, misses
swing again and movement off the pitch too, Gayle lets it go once again
short of a good length outside off, Gayle lets it be
comes down the track and has a swing at it, can't connect as it nips away
swing first up, moving away, pitching on the off, and then moving away further t beat the outside edge as Gayle tries to defend it off the back foot
